propositions: _apply_authorship silently returns when signing_key is configured but author_id is falsy and require_authenticated is off, providing no log or count of the skipped signing event
fsck's authorship tally is summed store-wide with no per-env breakdown, making a single environment at 0% signed rate invisible behind other environments' healthy signing volume

AC2 requires fsck to emit a counted UNSIGNED_ENV issue for any env_id with zero signed events or all Unknown-authored events that wrote after the store's earliest signed event, gated to avoid reporting dormant pre-signing environments

AC3 requires _apply_authorship to emit a logger.warning naming the event uuid, ticket, and which input was missing when signing is skipped due to lack of resolvable identity, while remaining best-effort and not starting to fail writes
The defect allowed beb1's unsigned, Unknown-authored event stream (~8900 events over one month) to go undetected because both the skip and the aggregate tally were silent
